name: plate_hx_pressure_drop_identification
title: Plate heat exchanger: two-phase pressure drops and heat-transfer coefficients, with a fictitious-orifice condenser pressure drop
summary: Plate-HX pressure-drop and heat-transfer correlations for a chevron plate pack (Thonon single-phase, Kuo condensation, Hsieh & Lin flow boiling) plus an identified fictitious orifice reproducing the measured condenser pressure drop; properties as CoolProp calls on the mixture R245fa+R134a (the source uses the EES REFPROP interface; stored run: pure R245fa).

verification.reference: EES stored solution (34 variables), native file; 29 of 34 common variables agree at the stored operating point; alpha_tp_cd, DELTAp_tp and h_tp_ev differ because of the two errors of the original (corrected here, see README)
verification.notes: max_rel_diff excludes the outputs affected by the corrections: alpha_tp_cd (211.1 vs EES 588.1), DELTAp_tp (38824 vs 33222), h_tp_ev (2112 vs 3848). Maximum of the others: 1.9e-2 on DELTAp_ev, then 5.1e-3 on h (R245fa transport properties, CoolProp as pinned by CoolSolve vs REFPROP 8). The original's molar convention, emulated in a scratch copy, reproduces the three stored values within 7 %. The native file is the verified file (CoolSolve branch fix/library-gaps-2); it reproduces the former pure-R245fa variant to 3e-13 on every common variable.
